notes: THE DECISION-RELEVANT NUMBER IN THE v6.1 SET, AND IT POINTS THE OPPOSITE WAY FROM THE HEADLINE. NVIDIA's own 8-GPU slice of a GB300 NVL72 delivers 16433 tok/s per GPU; CoreWeave's full 72-GPU rack of the same platform delivers 15779 tok/s per GPU. Nine times the GPUs for 8.6x the throughput. The NVL72's scale-up fabric buys almost nothing at Llama 2 70B FP4 because a single 8-GPU node already holds the entire quantized model and is not bandwidth-starved on weights. Note also that this 8-GPU slice is 20% FASTER per GPU than the 8-GPU B300 SXM node (13660/GPU, 109277 tok/s) despite both having 270GB and the same TensorRT-LLM 10.14 stack - GB300's 288GB and newer memory are worth having, but a rack of them is not worth having for this workload.
